dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero curvature; follows a straight vector from the dorsal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with near-zero pixel radius; shape is strictly pointed and triangular.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline at approximately 60 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate ratio of 1.5:1 base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Flat, linear slope with negligible curvature, indicating a near-infinite radius along the cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical extension with an approximate 1:1 pixel length to thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 165 degrees where the melon meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan luminescence; visible low-polygon mesh facets; stylized triangular tail flukes instead of lunate flukes.
